text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You've been doing great lately, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems as though you and your
trainer have
gotten really in sync with
each other.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I wouldn't go so far as to say that!
Though I
guess training has been going
well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I guess she is always adjusting my training regimen to suit my needs and encouraging me when I don't feel confident...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should put my gratitude into
words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I was just thinking about how well
things have
been going recently...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It... it feels like my training is starting to
pay off,
maybe. And I, um, think my
regimen has been...
good for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know you have a lot to do with all that,
so... I
just wanted to say thank you.
choice_data_list: ドーベルが頑張ってるからだよ
choice_data_list_en: It's because you're trying so hard, Dober

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm working hard! Anyway,
um... Bye!
choice_data_list: ドーベルが頑張ってるからだよ
choice_data_list_en: It's because you're trying so hard, Dober

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I hope we can keep it up, and, um...
Anyway, I'm
going to go for a run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober turns bright red and runs
away.
